I haven't drafted the mail to Pree. I replied to Dana in our DM to explain why and to ask for what's missing.

- **No record to work from:** I searched the knowledge brain, the shared files, and the #north-team and #general channels Dana belongs to. None of them mention Thornbury Cloth Co., and there's no earlier message in our DM about a mail to Pree. I don't have the 2027 rate, so I didn't put in a guessed number.
- **Dana's approval may not be enough:** A rate is a finance figure. It can go to Pree, who is on the Central team, without approval only if Dana owns the Thornbury account. Nothing I can see shows who owns it. If Dana doesn't, Anselm Grieve (CFO) or June Osei-Lark (deal desk) has to approve it first.
- **Mail address is fine:** Pree's address is internal (psundaram@pemberline.com), so Ruth Calloway doesn't need to approve the address.

I asked Dana for the rate, what the mail should say, and whether they own the account. If they do, I'll write the draft. If not, I'll ask Anselm or June for approval before drafting.
